messages:
Sam CSM: Quick sync — running a pre‑QBR rehearsal for Atlasica. Execs asked for a 3‑month token runway scenario (chat + embeddings) + an actionable mitigation list. Can folks jump on this? @Maria FinOps can you pull per‑route token counts for the last 30 days?

Maria FinOps: On it. I'll pull per‑route tokens, cost per model variant, and a 7‑day rolling avg. Anything else to include?

Sam CSM: Include hosted variants, Dedicated instances they use, and embeddings routes. Also capture any recent spikes during onboarding that pushed them over project limits.

Owen PM: Heads up — we deployed the prefix cache change last week. For sims please include scenarios with cache hit rates at 10%, 50%, and 80% so we can show impact on token burn and latency.

Jia SE: I can run the simulator with those cache assumptions. Do we have SLA targets to show tradeoffs vs cost?

Sam CSM: Exec asks: keep chat p95 <250ms, embeddings p95 <500ms. If we can’t hit that at projected throughput (10k rps peak) they want a fallback/rollback play.

billing-bot: Notice: Atlasica projected monthly spend = $42,300 (est). Proactive nudge threshold = $45,000.

Maria FinOps: Early look — embeddings are ~58% of projected spend due to large batch sizes in their pipeline. Options: reduce batch size, move embeddings to quantized Dedicated instances, or schedule bulk jobs off‑hours.

Sam CSM: Solid. We need those options framed as: cost delta, perf impact, implementation effort, owner, and customer‑facing messaging.

Jia SE: I'll prototype a KV prefix cache tweak + a 25% canary to capture perf delta and cost impact. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial numbers.

Owen PM: I'll draft the customer note: short, actionable lines — what we’ll do if usage spikes (throttle non‑critical embeddings, enable budget alerts, open billing escalation). Want to keep it calm and prescriptive.

Maria FinOps: Also recommending we wire automated budget alerts at 80% and 90% of their soft limit and a daily summary to their billing contact. I'll add configuration steps and screenshots for the console.

Sam CSM: Action owners summary for the QBR deck: Maria (cost sims + alert configs), Jia (technical mitigations + canary), Owen (stakeholder narrative + rollback message), Sam (QBR slide pack + exec bullets).

Jia SE: Noted. I'll attach simulator CSVs and a short README explaining assumptions (cache hit, batch sizes, model variant).

Sam CSM: One more ask — build three runway scenarios: baseline (current cadence), +30% growth, +90% growth. For each show cost delta, expected p95 change, and recommended mitigations.

Maria FinOps: I'll produce a table with those scenarios and highlight the breakpoints where we recommend moving to Dedicated or enabling throttles.

Sam CSM: Great — if no blockers I'll close this thread and start building slides. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Owen PM: No blockers from PM side. Happy to review slides once you have a draft.

billing-bot: Reminder scheduled: QBR rehearsal meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Sam CSM: Perfect — see you all then.
